carsten-holler--upside-down-goggles.why_en: Goggles flip the world upside down, and you have to learn to walk and pour again.
carsten-holler--upside-down-goggles.why_zh: 戴上护目镜，世界上下颠倒，你得重新学会走路、倒水。

art-com--zerseher.why_en: Wherever you look at the painting, your gaze smears it away.
art-com--zerseher.why_zh: 你的目光落在画上哪里，哪里就被抹花、溶解。

rebecca-horn--pencil-mask.why_en: A mask of pencils turns every movement of the head into a line on the wall.
rebecca-horn--pencil-mask.why_zh: 一副插满铅笔的面具，让头的每一次移动都在墙上留下一道线。

rebecca-horn--finger-gloves-body-extensi.why_en: Gloves with metre-long fingers let you touch the room from far away.
rebecca-horn--finger-gloves-body-extensi.why_zh: 手指长达一米的手套，让你从远处就能摸到房间。

richard-long--a-line-made-by-walking.why_en: Walking back and forth across a field leaves a line in the grass.
richard-long--a-line-made-by-walking.why_zh: 在草地上来回走，草上就留下了一条线。

anish-kapoor--sky-mirror.why_en: A huge dish mirror brings the sky down to the ground.
anish-kapoor--sky-mirror.why_zh: 一面巨大的碟形镜子，把天空搬到了地面上。

leandro-erlich--swimming-pool.why_en: Look down into the pool and people stand at the bottom, dry and breathing.
leandro-erlich--swimming-pool.why_zh: 往泳池里看，池底站着人，衣服没湿，呼吸如常。

nam-june-paik--tv-buddha.why_en: A Buddha sits watching a live image of itself on a television.
nam-june-paik--tv-buddha.why_zh: 一尊佛像坐在电视前，看着屏幕里实时的自己。

len-lye--wind-wand.why_en: One tall bending rod shows a whole city where the wind is.
len-lye--wind-wand.why_zh: 一根会弯的细长杆，让整座城市看见风在哪里。

etienne-jules-marey--smoke-machine.why_en: Lines of smoke make the invisible flow of air visible around an object.
etienne-jules-marey--smoke-machine.why_zh: 一缕缕烟线，让物体周围看不见的气流显现出来。

gjon-mili--picasso-light-drawings.why_en: Picasso draws in the air with a light, and the drawing hangs there for one exposure.
gjon-mili--picasso-light-drawings.why_zh: 毕加索拿着灯在空中作画，画在一次曝光里悬停在空中。

shigeo-fukuda--lunch-with-a-helmet-on.why_en: A tangle of forks and knives casts the shadow of a motorcycle.
shigeo-fukuda--lunch-with-a-helmet-on.why_zh: 一团刀叉勺，投下的影子却是一辆摩托车。

david-rokeby--very-nervous-system.why_en: In an empty room, your body's movement is instantly turned into music.
david-rokeby--very-nervous-system.why_zh: 在空房间里，你身体的每个动作都立刻变成音乐。

yayoi-kusama--obliteration-room.why_en: Every visitor adds colored dots until a white room disappears under them.
yayoi-kusama--obliteration-room.why_zh: 每位观众贴上几颗彩色圆点，直到白色房间被圆点淹没。

kurt-perschke--redball-project.why_en: A giant red ball gets squeezed into a different gap in the city each day.
kurt-perschke--redball-project.why_zh: 一个巨大的红球，每天被塞进城市里不同的缝隙。

rafael-lozano-hemmer--surface-tension.why_en: A giant eye on the wall follows you wherever you move.
rafael-lozano-hemmer--surface-tension.why_zh: 墙上一只巨大的眼睛，你走到哪里它就盯到哪里。

ana-mendieta--siluetas.why_en: The outline of her body, pressed into earth and water, stays after she is gone.
ana-mendieta--siluetas.why_zh: 她把身体的轮廓压进泥土和水里，人走了，轮廓还在。
